objective: Close only the tool-discovery scope-completeness residual without weakening the frozen TOOL_ROUTE_DISCOVERY_AND_SELECTION_001 contract, empirical extrapolation, or terminal replay.

interface_domain.discoverable_identity_definition: A tool identity is discoverable iff it is represented by the current candidate-visible tool authority directly or by at least one current authorized discovery source. An identity absent from all candidate-visible information is observationally unavailable to both matched routes under the frozen same-information rule and cannot be required as a uniquely selectable hidden action.
interface_domain.registry_contract: COMPLETE_DISCOVERY_REGISTRY enumerates every current candidate-visible discovery source for the frozen task authority, with source identity, epoch, cost, availability and authorization content-addressed by source_manifest_sha256.
interface_domain.source_result_contract: A current DISCOVERY_RESULT marked complete contains the full finite tool listing exposed by that source at the bound registry and source epochs. Stale results do not count as source exhaustion.
interface_domain.unknown_identity_scope: Discovered tool_id values are arbitrary nonempty strings; the V4 policy has no enumerated tool-id vocabulary and unions identities returned by all current authorized sources.
interface_domain.capability_truth_boundary: Tool metadata never proves hidden capability support. Only current-epoch SAFE_CAPABILITY_PROBE receipts may establish positive or negative support for a required capability.
interface_domain.probe_authority: A newly discovered tool may be probed only when safe_probe_allowed is explicitly true. Absence is fail-closed.
interface_domain.version_semantics: Public TOOL_VERSION_CHANGED events advance the effective tool epoch and make older capability receipts inadmissible.
interface_domain.constraint_language: The frozen generic constraint evaluator is exact for and/or/not plus eq, neq, in, not_in, lt, le, gt, ge, contains and exists over candidate-visible metadata.
interface_domain.cost_objective: Among currently available, authorized, constraint-admissible tools, select the least-cost identity whose every required capability has current positive probe evidence; ties are deterministic by tool_id.

legacy_projection.rule: If discovery_registry is absent, V4 delegates directly to the exact verified legacy candidate.
legacy_projection.effect: The frozen 180-case terminal inputs contain no discovery_registry, so the prior immutable sample result is behaviorally preserved without replay.

v3_counterexample.defect: V3 probes or selects an already-visible tool before exhausting unqueried discovery sources. Therefore a source can contain a cheaper sufficient tool that V3 never discovers before selecting a more expensive route.
v3_counterexample.repair: V4 exhausts every current available and authorized source before any capability probe or selection.

independent_verification_requirement: A public clean-room verifier must bind the exact V4 implementation, its mutation/adversarial tests, this scope relation and the frozen contract/firewall blobs; only then may the scope atom be considered for a separate acceptance reduction.
